name: Viking 5 Series 30” Stainless Steel 4-Burner Liquid Propane Rangetop with Polished Chrome Trim
shortDescription: Equipped with 15,000 BTU Pro sealed burner system ­ and an 18,500 BTU TruPower Plus™ burner on select models ­ custom gas rangetops deliver the ultimate in performance.

features.text: Equipped with 15,000 BTU Pro sealed burner system ­ and an 18,500 BTU TruPower Plus™ burner on select models ­ custom gas rangetops deliver the ultimate in performance. The VariSimmer™ setting and SureSpark™ Ignition System ensure perfect temperature control even at the most delicate settings. Exclusive stainless steel knobs and included island trim add a subtle dash of style to any kitchen.
Sculpted polished chrome bezels and stainless steel knobs bring new clarity and cohesion to the Viking 5 Series Range, refining its presence while honoring its iconic heritage.
The TruPower Plus™ front burner on select Custom Series rangetops lets you cook like a pro with 18,500 BTUs of professional power.

Keep spills in one place with the raised edges of our exclusive  one-piece tooled porcelainized cooking surface. Raised edges around perimeter seal top to completely contain spills.  Porcelanized for easy cleaning, durability and long lasting finish.
The VariSimmer™ Setting on ALL burners provides gentle, even simmering at precisely low cooking temperatures.
The exclusive SureSpark™ Ignition System ensures automatic ignition/re-ignition should the burners extinguish any time while cooking.

Cook like a pro with up to 18,500 BTUs and infinite settings of easy-to-clean high performance sealed burners. Combination of unique patented burner and surface design provides cleanability plus superior performance at any temperature setting.
Illuminates control knobs with a soft blue glow, enhancing visibility and adding a professional touch to your kitchen.
Comes with a matching stainless steel island trim, offering a seamless and polished look for your kitchen island installation.
Two-year full – complete product; Ninety-day full – cosmetic parts such as glass, painted items, and decorative items; Five-year limited - electric element
